promises.quote: the Trust has now implemented improved handover procedures between paramedics and A&E staff which should ensure that the triage nurse sees any patient notes made by the paramedics and documents this action.
promises.summary: Implement improved handover procedures to ensure triage nurses see paramedic notes

promises.quote: NWAS has advised that its staff always leave a patient report form (PRF) at every hospital following a patient transfer. A copy of this form also remains with the patient following admission
promises.summary: Leave patient report form (PRF) at hospitals for patient handover

promises.quote: FGH has very specific patient handover procedures which require NWAS to leave a copy of the PRF with the hospital receptionist for placing with hospital documentation which is subsequently passed to the triage nurse once the patient has been booked in
promises.summary: Require NWAS to leave PRF with hospital receptionist for triage nurse access

reports.title: Regan Smith: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: The information to save Regan's life (his abnormal blood glucose reading) was in the possession of the NHS at a time when lifesaving treatment could have been given to him on the 25th January 2023
concerns.hazard: delayed or missed critical clinical information

concerns.quote: Regan's death occurred as the result of an identifiable single point of failure (the ineffective handover process), as this led to a significant and known clinical finding being unavailable to his treating clinicians

there was no national protocol, no national standard operating procedures, and no National Institute for Health and Care Excellence guidance, in relation to the conduct of patient handovers at Accident and Emergency Units

there is no national protocol, no national standard operating procedures, and no National Institute for Health and Care Excellence guidance, to ensure basic observations are confirmed as being handed over by ambulance personnel, and confirmed as being received by the receiving Accident and Emergency personnel

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that reliance on verbal handover without reliable documentation or system compatibility can cause critical clinical information to be lost. The earlier case concerned general patient details; the later case involved a specific abnormal blood glucose reading.
links.earlier_quote: When Mr Moulton was admitted to A & E on the 13
links.later_quote: Evidence heard that the handover system in Regan's case was reliant on both ambulance and Accident and Emergency personnel making and receiving a verbal handover.
